    Primitive-corner factorization of the square of the Jacobson radical #

    Every primitive-corner element of Jac(A)^2 lies in the two-sided Hom span of one composite of two radical corner morphisms. Comparability of BGRS Hom subbimodules collapses a finite sum of such composites to one principal span.
